scheduler.merge_rule: After all shards finish, rerun the unsharded command. Digest-matched lane outputs are skipped, then the aggregate and scientific acceptance are written.

acceptance_criteria: The exact blocked-basis equivalence test passes before any campaign: the periodic 15-block nearest-neighbour Hamiltonian is the L=30 PXP ring, not a proxy model.
All six initial-state/refinement lanes reach t*Omega=120, while the six-site panel is cut at t*Omega=100 and the one-site panel at 120.
Norm drift and total forbidden-state weight are each at most 1e-6, absolute energy drift is at most 1e-5, product-state entropies vanish, and the entropy bounds 0<=S1<=1 and 0<=S6<=6 hold.
The maximum curve change under halved time step and increased bond dimension is at most 0.04 bits in each declared refinement comparison.
The generated curves retain the paper's qualitative separation: the late six-site entropy from the all-zero state exceeds the Z2 result and the late Z2 one-site entropy oscillates more strongly.

Any stable difference is first classified as reproduction_defect, parameter_ambiguity, insufficient_compute or inconclusive; paper_error_candidate is allowed only when paper_exact, convergence, at least two independent cross-checks, source pinpoint and fresh independent review all pass.
The generated-data manifest confirms that author code, author arrays, digitized curves, source pixels and PDF pixels were not numerical inputs.
